evidence.quote: Die Höhe der Studiengebühren beläuft sich auf 500,00 Euro pro Semester für einen Bachelorstudiengang und 700,00 Euro pro Semester für einen Masterstudiengang.
Die Studiengebühren betragen 500,00 Euro pro Semester für das Studium in einem Bachelorstudiengang und 700,00 Euro pro Semester für das Studium in einem Masterstudiengang.

notes: The EUR 500 per semester is a general university-wide fee for foreign students (not specific to this programme); the DAAD page states for this programme: "Tuition fees per semester None" and "Student union fee: 97 EUR" and that tuition fees for non-EU students (approx. 500 EUR per semester) "are being discussed and might apply soon". No document list (e.g. school-leaving certificate) is named on the supplied pages. The recurring deadline (15 July) is stated for applicants from all countries, not specifically non-EU/foreign-diploma applicants. Language certificates: DAAD names TOEFL Essentials and IELTS Academic; German A2 mentioned on the programme page (no test named).

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL Essentials: 6 Reading: 6 Listening: 6 Speaking: 6 Writing: 6 IELTS Academic: 6
